digest.component_or_area: store git operations / local lock contention handling
propositions: Local git call sites contend unbounded on store locks (index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) under high concurrent agent use with no automatic contention handling, surfacing errors to agents instead of absorbing them

Per-store advisory fcntl lock plus bounded jittered retry/backoff on git call sites serializes local index-mutating operations and self-heals transient lock conflicts silently, with one actionable error only on stuck lock exhaustion
Watchdog timeouts (120s local, 300s metrics) on git subprocesses distinguish wedged filesystem from slow operations while rebar holds the store lock
Uncontended store writes add zero latency via non-blocking advisory lock fast path, with intentional backoff sleeps jittered by uniform[0.75, 1.25] to de-synchronize competing agents
